changeSet.author: mateusz
changeSet.sql: create sequence person_id_seq start with 1 increment by 100

changeSet.author: mateusz
changeSet.sql: create table author ( birth_year integer, death_year integer, id bigint generated by default as identity, first_name varchar(255) not null, last_name varchar(255) not null, primary key (id) )

changeSet.author: mateusz
changeSet.sql: create table book ( available boolean not null, author_id bigint not null, id bigint generated by default as identity, category varchar(255), title varchar(255) not null, primary key (id) )

changeSet.author: mateusz
changeSet.sql: create table employee ( age integer not null, id integer not null, salary integer not null, name varchar(255), position varchar(255), pesel varchar(11), primary key (id) )

changeSet.author: mateusz
changeSet.sql: create table import_status ( id integer generated by default as identity, processed integer not null, status tinyint check (status between 0 and 3), finish_date timestamp(6), start_date timestamp(6), submit_date timestamp(6), failed_reason varchar(255), file_name varchar(255), primary key (id) )

changeSet.author: mateusz
changeSet.sql: create table student ( age integer not null, id integer not null, scholarship integer not null, name varchar(255), std_group varchar(255), pesel varchar(11), primary key (id) )
